name: Boosodian
description: The Boosodians were a sentient species with gray skin and twenty eyes that lived in the galaxy. Amuncie Tidian was a Boosodian who worked as a forger. In 9 BBY, a Boosodian vendor on Daiyu sold clothes to Obi-Wan Kenobi and Leia Organa whilst they were escaping the planet.
